basic_details.short_information: National e-Governance Division, Digital India Corporation (NeGD) has announced recruitment for 2 vacancies for the Product Manager (AI) post on a contract basis. The engagement is purely temporary for an initial period of 3 years, extendable as per project requirements, with New Delhi as the place of posting. Candidates applying for the Product Manager (AI) post must hold a B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Data Science or related discipline, with 10-12 years of product management experience including 4-6 years in AI/ML, and be a maximum of 55 years of age as on 26 October 2026. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NeGD has advertised a total of 02 vacancies for the Product Manager (AI) position on a contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the prescribed educational qualification, experience, and age limit criteria to apply for the position. Must Have: B.Tech./B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or related technical field. Preferred: MBA/M.Tech. in Management, Systems Engineering, or Product Management certification. Highly Desirable: Advanced degree (M.S./M.Tech.) in AI/ML, Computer Science, or related quantitative field. Desirable Certifications: Product Management certifications (Certified Scrum Product Owner, Product School AI PM Certification), AI/ML certifications (DeepLearning.AI, Google AI Product Manager), Agile/SAFe Product Owner certifications, Programme Management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe). 10–12 years in product management with minimum 4–6 years in AI/ML or digital transformation initiatives. 3–5 years in senior product management roles leading AI-powered products from conception to launch. 2–3 years managing cross-functional teams including data scientists, ML engineers, and business stakeholders. Proven track record delivering enterprise-grade AI products with measurable business impact. Prior experience in programme delivery for government or PSU initiatives desirable. content_sections.heading: NeGD Product Manager (AI) Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be responsible for the following key areas: Define and own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-driven government services within the owned pod cluster. Lead product discovery, market research, and user research to identify citizen pain points and opportunities for AI intervention. Translate complex business requirements and government use cases into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Oversee complete product lifecycle from ideation through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement for 8–10 concurrent AI initiatives. Manage cross-functional collaboration between AI/ML engineers, data scientists, MLOps, UX designers, business analysts, and government stakeholders. Define and track key product metrics (KPIs, OKRs) including user adoption, accuracy, response times, cost per transaction, and citizen satisfaction scores. Manage product budgets, resource allocation, vendor evaluation, and contract negotiations. Ensure Responsible AI principles are applied, including ethical AI deployment, bias mitigation, transparency, and compliance with MeitY guidelines. Own the programme risk register and drive mitigation of delivery, technical, agency, and compliance risks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NeGD Product Manager (AI)
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at ora.digitalindiacorporation.in . Check the detailed notification and download the guidelines from www.negd.gov.in or www.dic.gov.in . Fill out the online application form with required educational, professional, and personal details. Upload necessary documents supporting qualifications, age, and experience. Submit the application online on or before 26.10.2026. Candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must apply through the proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate (NOC).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Screening of applications will be based on qualifications, age, and relevant experience. NeGD reserves the right to fix a higher threshold of qualifications and experience for screening to limit the number of candidates for interview. Only shortlisted candidates shall be invited for interviews. NeGD reserves the right not to select any of the candidates without assigning any reason thereof.
